name: add-mcp-oauth follows the skill
prompt: Protect my MCP server with OAuth.

judge.check: Agent followed add-mcp-oauth. It used Streamable HTTP. It kept /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource public. It returned 401 with WWW-Authenticate and resource_metadata. It called validateToken with audience set to the dashboard Server URL.
Agent asked the human to write missing SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, and SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET into .env. It did not invent those values.

Agent registered well-known, then Bearer middleware, then the MCP POST. It used the dashboard Server URL as audience. It did not invent Metadata JSON or prepend https:// onto SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL.
Agent did not write API keys or client credentials. It did not expose AgentKit tools over MCP.
